name: reward-bench-CodeRM-8B-normal
description: A benchmark for evaluating code reward models (CodeRM-8B) on their ability to score or rank code outputs according to human preferences. It provides examples and labels used to measure agreement between model-assigned rewards and human judgments, useful for reward-model training and selection. The dataset focuses on coding tasks and pairwise/preference-style comparisons rather than direct generation metrics.
reputation: An emerging, research-oriented benchmark used by groups experimenting with reward models for code; moderate adoption within coding-RM communities.
